message: Changes to the children of the '{0}' property cannot be observed because '{0}' is not an auto-property. Access the child through an auto-property or a field of '{1}' instead.
title: Changes to children of non-auto properties of the current type cannot be observed.
rationale: The report site (DependencyGraphBuilder.Visitor.ValidatePathElement, Stem branch) fires when a non-auto property of the current type is used as the parent of a member access and its type DOES implement INotifyPropertyChanged, so 'unless the property type implements INotifyPropertyChanged' is false. The advice is also wrong: '{1}' is the current type, which already implements INotifyPropertyChanged; [Constant] cannot be applied to a property (AttributeUsage is Method, Struct, Class); and the Stem check does not consult the observability contract, so ConfigureObservability has no effect.
codeChange: LAMA5163 has a second definition, DeclaringTypeDoesNotImplementInpcLeaf (reported for a property of a base type that does not implement INotifyPropertyChanged, see Bug1003 test). Give one of them a distinct ID. The Leaf message suggests 'marking '{0}' with [Constant]', but [Constant] cannot be applied to a property; it should say 'marking '{1}' with [Constant]' (the type), since IsConstantMember honors the options of the containing type.
